urdu.name: لطفیہ
urdu.long_meaning: Lutfuye (لطفیہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم لطفیہ، مہربان ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

faq.a: Lutfuye is associated with the Arabic form لُطْفِيَّة, whose core sense is lutfuye; of kindness (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Lutfuye?
faq.a: Lutfuye is associated with Arabic. Lutfuye is the Turkish form of Arabic لُطْفِيَّة (Luṭfiyya), the feminine relative form of لُطْف, meaning 'of kindness'.
Yes — the underlying form لُطْفِيَّة is Arabic.
Lutfuye can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Lutfuye should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Luṭfiyya is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Lutfuye mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Lutfuye is rendered لطفیہ and carries the sense لطفیہ، مہربان.

faq.q: What does Lutfuye mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Lutfuye is rendered لطفیه and carries the sense لطفیه، مهربان.
A romanized syllable approximation is lut-fuye. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Lutfuye?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Lutfuye, lutfuye. Script forms are لطفيه, لطفیه, لطفیہ, لُطْفِيَّة, लुत्फ़िया.

faq.q: Is Lutfuye a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
